text: These work great
These little STK Reusable Cups for Keurig machines are wonderful and works as advertised.  Thanks for making something both economical and environmentally sound.

This does not fully seat in the k145 office pro.  Appears to work but for now, based on how they fit, I have to knock a couple stars.  Alternate product di oro caffe fits great.  go for that for the k145 office pro
Sometimes keeps machine from running unless you hold down the top. Will be ordering different ones and tossing these
The product is exactly what I wanted. It was well wrapped and it works well!!

Terrible product...Did not fit properly in my K-130 unit...Very hard to close...Was afraid I was going to break my coffee maker....Finally forced it and brewed the coffee and there were coffee grounds all in my cup....This product did not work as advertised...
These cups work great on our Keurig machine and make it possible to use our own coffee and not have to purchase expensive Kcups.
The description stated it was compatible with my mode, however it was really difficult to close.
These have been working perfectly and seem to hold up well.  They sure save a lot of money.

Great invention!  I use these every day.  A wonderful alternative to the ready-made plastic cups.  No weird plastic taste, and no more concerns about the fact that the ready-made cups are not recyclable.
Fit with my Keurig K55 (the box label) or K40 (label on the item). I am using maxwell house original roast coffee. Very good reusable filter.
Doesn't fit keurig.  It broke my keurig. Also leaves grouns in the cup right after brewing.
Works well, easy to clean.  It does leave some sediment in the cup but well worth it to avoid costly Keurig coffee.
Works Perfect
I bought these reusable filters for my Keurig single serve K130 model. The description specifically says that the filters will fit this model, but the lid will not close with the filter in.
Perfect for our Keurig!
Did not work with my kerurig.
Item is great!
Works well.
Most unhappy. Do not fit Keurig.

Would give ZERO stars! Product came in a small bag, which I'm guessing was the reason one was broken from the start. They did not fit my Keurig I own one of the models this was designed to work with, Big LIE It did not. NOT WORTH IT !! Buy another product guarantee it will work better!!
These are the best one's that I've found so far!!!
All good
Just bought a new Keurig and it is nice to be able to use  whatever brand of coffee we want and this product allows us to.

I've been waiting for this beauty to come into my life. It was a pain just finding a reusable filter for my B130 Keurig. I'm still going to have to tweak it a bit since my coffee is either too weak or too strong, but I'll get there now with the help of this product. Just a heads up, clean out the coffee grounds as soon as you can (this tip will be a lifesaver for when you have to clean the product out) and be careful since the filter will be still hot.
Works great in the B155 Keurig system.

This is the only reusable k cup I have found that works with the professional K150 model.  While the cup does sit tight so do other k cups.  The only issue being that other k cups are flimsy and remove easily.  This one will take a bit of effort to remove once used so be careful of the hot contents.  Still a great item for those coffees that have been converted to k cups yet.
We use these 3-4 times a day. Well constructed. We've only used one. They will last forever.
They work great
Although the product says it fits k145 I was nervous because of some of the reviews. I have to say I'm pleased with my order. Works and fits great. Fast shipping also.

Technically it works in my K-cup office pro model brewer but as others have mentioned - the coffee is extremely weak.  Disappointed as I go through a lot of coffee and hate how much waste Im creating by throwing all those spent pods out.

I really deliberated about buying these as so many of the reviews were negative. However, I was pleased to find that these work perfectly in my Keurig 1.0 machine. No mess, coffee as good as standard pots and robust enough to clean quickly and re-use throughout the day.
No regrets in purchasing this product and I would recommend to others.
Good using kit !!
Works perfectly in my K130, which is notoriously hard to fit.  This k-cup is definitely a higher quality cup than most.  I am very happy with it.

Great coffee filters. They work great on a Mr Coffee BVMC-KG5-001 model. Store bought versions are not compatible it seems. Been using them daily for 2 months or so.

Not related to the filter quality i have noticed the coffee from these filters are weaker than what you get from a k cup. I think it may be because the coffee grounds in a k cup are visibly finer than typical brand name coffee like folgers.

Maybe you can achieve finer level by finding a place to grind your coffee but no doubt price will be higher or buy a home grinder with a fine setting.
As is usually the case, this purchase from Amazon, was a great deal. The STK cups work like a charm!
Very handy and I love the dolphin pattern.
I love reusable cups because they are helping the environment.

I spent hours researching reusuable Kcups and based on all the positive reviews ordered these these 3  refillable K cups  They are better than I ever expected. I had just purchased a new Keurig Office Pro K 145 Brewer and the Keurig  refillable cups did not fit which really made me angry with the Keurig corporation. But these kcups work perfectly and are made well. And it's nice to have 3. This is the first review I've ever put on Amazon.  I highly recommend them.
Bought these for my husband because he drinks a lot of coffee and K-cups get expensive.  Unfortunately they do not fit well in our commercial Keurig model, they are just a bit too big.
it was a waste of money  Did not fit my K130 as noted
Works as advertised

Takes a little finesse to insert them correctly in a K130 model. I did end up accidentally punching a hole in the bottom of one.
They do make nice strong coffee though, and are easy to clean out.
Fits perfectly and works great. Was delivered fast.

I have a keyring office pro K145. These work great! They are not as convenient as the actual k cups, but I was looking for an economical environmentally friendly alternative and this is it! Packaged well, arrived when I expected them, great find and buy! Thank you!!
Just what we wanted

Does not work with the Keurig K155. It's a shame that we are obligated to buy the coffee pods they provide. They should discount these pods... I have my own brand of coffee I use in PR so my K155 will not be used much. They should inform their buyers of this fact for this machine is not cheap and one that is not accesible to many!!! I am very disspointed. Mostly with KEURIG..
I like the design and fits my Keurig single cup serving

It says on the advertisement it works for K155 machine, yet it does not!  "STK Keurig Reusable K Cup 3 Count for Keurig Classic Brewers K55, K145, K40, K155, K150".  The product packaging did not say anything about the K155.  The K155 is a commercial product and the pod size needs to be smaller to fit in the receiver.  It does not fit into the machine!  I sent the product back!
They work great and fast shipping!
They work as advertised. Be careful when inserting to align the bottom hole punch with the slot in the reusable cup
They seem well made, but the coffee comes out so weak. I think it's a problem with all reusable Keurig cups, though.
These fit our K150 Single Cup Commercial K-Cup brewer wonderfully.  Easy to clean out.  We use our Folgers Black Silk with these so the Keurig can be cost efficient.

Finally found these elusive narrower k-cups for the K150. These work perfectly when all other reusable cups would leak or not fit at all.
THESE ARE THE NARROW CUPS THAT FIT THE K150 AND THE OTHER KRUIG COMMERCIAL UNITS.
Works very well..

Exactly what I needed. It arrived quickly, nicely packaged and in good condition. I used it for loose leaf tea and did not have any issue with the leaves leaking out into my cup. The balls are smaller, so it doesn't hold that much, but it's perfect for me.
They are good for the price. Some of the mesh balls came a bit dented, but that does not interfere with its purpose. Don't really like the locking mechanism.

And when you're not making tea you can put little colored leds in them and use them for Christmas tree ornaments!!LOL  And yes, you should have ta pay me for that new and innovative idea! I am sure that your sales will rocket after people read this! >:-}

Work as advertised.  Sturdy construction and hold plenty of product.  I am using them for raw tea as well as raw coffee grounds and they work perfectly.  One tablespoon of coffee coarsely ground fit in each pod.  Decided to put two of the 6 inside my camping bag.
just as expected and work beautifully!
They are great for my wife. She is now back drinking her cups of tea, since she does not meed to make a large pot/
Exactly as described. Great price. Received very quickly.
Wonderful tea balls. Use them every day.
I have used one of the tea balls about 20 times so far and it looks good as new and working great.
Excellent product.  Well made, durable.  Would buy again but I expect these to last a long time.
work perfectly. Very fine teas do not hold well in the ball, but that does not stop my enjoyment of the tea.
Great little tea balls at a great price.  Perfect size for 1 cup.

I have yet to make any tea with them yet, but they feel strong in the wire mesh, the clip on the side holds solid, and the chain is good. I recently bought a bunch of loose leaf teas and realized after the fact that I had no more tea balls, so I decided to get a 6 pack here! Thank you!
They rust and let the tea leaves through but for the price they work.
They work pretty well for the most part, although the hinges sometimes get loose, so we have to re-bend them so they hold the tea tightly and don't let any particles into your glass.
Excelent
Great product, works very well for herbal teas.
Love them will re-order.
Love'em
Great tea balls. I've been using them for three months now and they are still as good as new. Great quality and great price!
Very pleased with quality and price of product. Thanks so much !

Very nice quality. I have a collection of bushpots or "billys", [way too many according to my wife], so these were distributed among them.  They will earn their keep over a campfire brewing a good strong cup.

These work really well and look nice. However, black tea has stained a couple of them and they look rusty. Still totally usable because they aren't actually rusty, but I probably can't use them for guests anymore. Otherwise it's a great value for a working product.
These are great! Very well made. The Friendly Swede provided excellent service. Will buy from them again.

I've had many of these Mesh tea balls, but none was as of good quality as these.  The others we got bent easily and wouldn't close properly anymore, but I can see these are sturdier and the material is of the highest quality.  We've been happily making tea every night now.
Nice appearance and quality at a very reasonable price!
Beats the paper tea bags and you can create your own custom flavors. Just make sure the tea you're planning to use isn't too fine or it'll just come out of the mesh.
Very happy with my purchase. well-made, easy to use and the small mesh really contains the finer tea leaves.
Some of the very fine pieces of tea still make it through the holes, but that is expected. Easy to use and clean. Like the adjustable chain!

Four of the six tea balls were damaged, allowing tea to escape into the cup.  Amazon, of course, will refund my money completely when I return them, but it is irritating to have to do that for such a small item - I will probably wind up throwing them away.  The two intact tea balls performed perfectly.
Perfect for afternoon tea for a variety of favors . Clean up nicely.

Very well constructed and easy to use.  Perfect for a single cup or use multiples for brewing an entire pot.  It's easy to blend different flavors or types of tea together.  Very satisfied with my purchase.

Never used a tea strainer before but needed one for a tea cleanse I was going to do. Today was first day I tried them and have to say the tea leaves leak out immediately. Below is a pic of my cup of tea after one steep of the tea. After letting it sit the leaves sink to the bottom so they are avoided but have to say I expected much less leaves to leak out...

I did like that 6 came in the package. So you get a lot for the price which is why I chose this one after other more expensive single strainers.
These are perfect. The tea stays in the mesh ball. Amazing product. Just what I was looking for.

I ordered these a few months ago, and they get used on a daily basis by me and my friends. In that time, many of the balls have lost their chains, and half of them have a very loose seal. I often end up accidentally drinking leaves because of this.
So far this seems to be a really great product.
These are great! The only complaint I had is that one of them has a little gap in the closure so it let tea through it. For this price, I just tossed it and use the other 5.

I initially ordered their long handled tea infusers and while they worked, they weren't exactly what i needed. I make hot tea with fresh mint leaves, fresh grated ginger, fennel seeds, etc. I wanted something that kept my ingredients out of my drinking tea but infused them with the flavor. I also wanted something that was easy to clean. These fit the bill perfectly! The company actually reached out to me and recommend I try these since I didn't completely love their other product. How awesome is that? It's nice to know that The Friendly Swede cares about their customers and want you to be happy with their products and provide personalized recommendations.

These mesh tea infusers are easy to use and seal up well with the ingredients. They have a small clasp on the side that slides in and closes the two halves together. This also makes it easy to clean since the entire thing opens up when you are done and I never have to worry about grated ginger or small fennel seeds getting stuck in there. These also have a hook at the end so you can place it on the tip of your cup so when you are ready to remove the infuser, you don't have to dig it out. Simply unhook it from your cup and remove it.

I am so happy with these and have been using them daily since I received them. That in addition to the follow-up from the company have made me a happy customer. I wouldn't hesitate to buy these again or other products from them.

Love these! I don't use them for tea, but for something totally different (to place hides in for a dog sport called nosework). I love them because they're extremely sturdy, don't rust, and hold up with heavy use. The clasps don't get loose and the mesh is nice and sturdy too. Bought 2 boxes already and will surely be buying more in another few months!

I love these.  Rather than paying high prices for tea, I buy bulk tea and keep it in an airtight container.  When I need to, I scoop my tea into these little stainless steel tea balls.  Locking them closed may be difficult for people with hand issues.  But I don't have any coordination issues.  It's as easy as using a tea bag.  After making tea, I flush the contents down the disposal and put the tea balls in the dishwasher.  I've had no rust or any other issues yet.  I'm delighted.
perfect little tea infusers/balls
These work very well for large leaf teas only.  If you have an herbal or something else with small pieces, you'll end up with some leaves in your tea.
They did not match the machine even though the claim is they do.  Avoid.
Since the wash drum only aligned to one side of the wash machine, I only needed to use 2 of the 4 bolts. No complaints, works as expected. Wash machine arrived at its new home safe and intact.

I'm sure they would work great for the correct model. The description here, or lack thereof, leads you to believe that you have the right part number until moving day and you try to install them and are screwed.

Worked great
Saved a service call when moving our washer
Works great

We looked up if this part was for our Whirlpool Duet WFW95HEDW0 washer and it said it was.  In fact if you type in "WFW95HEDW0 shipping bolts" into Google, the first link is to this product on Amazon.  However, it is NOT the right part and we had to desperately scramble to find shipping bolts for our move.  We lucked out in that a very nice Home Depot employee loaned us theirs from a display model.  If you have a Whirlpool Duet WFW95HEDW0, the part you need is W10498442.  They are 4 small sized bolts, with no long ones.
they worked for our move and arrived in short order
Could only use shorter bolts.  Long were too long even though it said it would fit my Whirlpool Duet Sport front loader.
These did not fit.  We removed the orange plastic and were then able to get them to work.

They worked as expected. The instructions are not very good though. They claims some older models use this same bracket but you need to cut part of the plastic off. These did not appear to work in mine but it was because you need to have someone move the drum until the holes line up. It would have been helpful if they said that because I cut the plastic thinking I had an old model.
Fit perfect
One of the two longer bolts broke upon installation, right at the threads, leaving the threaded portion in the carriage. Amazing. But otherwise they were fine and fit as expected.
Worked out great. Much needed and used. Thankbyou
They didn't quite fit in 2 of the holes and there were no instructions at all to help me.

One of the shorter bolts broke when attempting to remove from the washer drum. They appeared to be factory direct parts, which leads me to believe there's very little Whirlpool/Maytag actual get right.
exactly right so I could move my washer without issues.
Just as advertised.  Did require 2 people to install
i like how they look

I ordered the wrong ones!  Really the site makes it easy to add your washer model number to find the correct part.  I have a Maytag Maxima HE.  Model #W10498442 Whirlpool Washing Machine Shipping Bolt kit would have worked!  Giving 5 stars because of the search ability to select the correct item.  Giving myself 1 star for being careless.
The work.
Did the thing it was supposed to do.
Needed to buy these prior to moving. Price is 1/3 of what they charge retail. It did take a while to screw these in the washer, but they definitely did the trick.

I'd heard that transit bolts were a must when moving a front load washing machine. But we're do I get them? Are they all the same or do I need a certain size.  I certainly hadn't kept the ones that came in the machine. So I went to Lowes and asked. I learned that I did need them or I'd risk breaking the machine beyond repair, but they didn't have them. Perfect. Hmmm...could Amazon help? Sure enough there they were! The internet page even had special 'make sure these fit YOUR model' section at the top. Told me where to find my model number and allowed me to ensure that these bolts would serve my purpose. They arrived on time, fit my machine, and protected it from a VERY turbulent move. It did take a you tube video to ensure I installed them correctly. I'd suggest installing the day before you move to limit your time and frustration on moving day.
Worked good.
Worked exactly as advertised. Have to remember to get all four in before your tighten them down though........

Well, they are bolts, and did the bolt thing. I didn't give it 5 stars because I did have a hard time getting the bolt into our machine due to plastic chads from the molding of the bolts, but all in all they did what we needed and we got our washer moved over 5 states 3 days in a moving truck.

Several of these snapped while installed during shipping of our machine. Now bolt is stuck and I cannot remove - fortunately doesn't affect the function. I've moved the same machines twice before and did not use these and the machines worked just fine after... not sure if we just got lucky or if you actually need these.

This is the second replacement roller assembly I've purchased for our KitchenAid dishwasher. Unfortunately the rollers and arms on the upper tray rack are made of cheap plastic and will break if you overload the dishwasher. These replacements work fine.
Fit just as good as the OEM parts. Hopefully they last longer. Was delivered quickly and on time.

Overpriced but necessary to fix my dishwasher rack. BTW, there are great videos on youtube that show you how to install it yourself and save $. I have had to replace this little item three times on a three year old dishwasher. Now I keep an extra on hand. The first time I replaced it, it took awhile and caused some frustration, but once you've done it, it's pretty easy. I just think dishwasher parts should last longer.
This product worked perfectly but I did find it a little hard to remove the older damaged part. There were adequate instructions for me to follow we I had to YouTube it.
Inexpensive way to repair my Kitchen Aid dishwasher. Worked wonderfully.
Just saved me a couple hundred dollars! Wasn't sure about how long it would take me to figure out how to replace this piece. From the time I opened the package and to completing it...10 minutes.
Just saved me a couple hundred dollars! Wasn't sure about how long it would take me to figure out how to replace this piece. From the time I opened the package and to completing it...10 minutes.
saved us a load of money not buying the OEM part

Good replacement for what is ultimately a lousy design flaw on the Kitchen Aid dishwasher. I need to replace these guys every 1 to 2 years because of the bad design - so thank goodness they are affordable and easy to fit

This product only lasted for about two months before it broke.  We have pretty hard water in our house so that may have been the issue.  The OEM parts lasted just less than two year.  But two months seems a bit ridiculous.  You can check my other reviews on Amazon.  I don't think I ever given a product less than three stars before--few less than four.  The product fits as a replacement, but I would be very suspicious about lifetime unless you have soft water.
Worked perfectly.
Right part installed quickly.
Wrong wheels, and still junk material.

It is not the same quality as the original part. The rollers are made of cheaper plastic compared to the original. The main body looks like it is made of the same material. I ordered 2 of these. One of them arrived slightly bent and it does not seem to take a straight shape after installation. I am a little disappointed. But it is cheaper than ordering a replacement directly from the manufacturer.
Fast and just what we needed
fit perfect

This replacement part fit perfectly in our 5 year old whirlpool dish washer.  After reviewing a few YouTube install videos before purchasing the part, it took 15 minutes even for a non handy girl to replace  both sides of the top dish washer tray after the part was delivered. Would like to give it 5 stars but the  part is plastic and will eventually  wear out again.
Perfect match
It fit perfectly and work great.

Don't buy this, this is the same piece of junk that came with the dishwasher. It has nothing to do with how much you put in the top rack , it is just a terrible design.  Buy the part suggested in the review by S***sumom. It is made of metal. ( Now there's a brilliant idea!) You will need a special screwdriver. The directions are terrible but just google the part number on you tube and you will find better directions.
fits just like the original which fell apart. Time will tell if it lasts longer. We have installed about 3 month ago.

Easy and inexpensive way to fix a common problem on your own. Saves lots of money that you wd spend on a repair man. This will fix the broken wheel that leads to dishwasher tray falling and not properly pulling. Easy to install and use.
broke in 39 days
Worked perfectly!!!!
This fits nicely and was easy to install. But it broke after 9 months of use.
Worked great.
